title: Board Force Graph Respects Locked Nodes
description: Force graph layout must pin locked fixture nodes: no position/velocity updates on redraw; still participate in edges/repulsion as fixed bodies.
summary: Force graph layout now treats `lockedNodeIds` as pinned bodies: initial positions are preserved, jitter skips them, and each integration step zeroes forces then re-applies pin constraints after velocity integration. `RedrawFixtureOptions` accepts top-level `lockedNodeIds` merged into `ForceGraphLayoutOptions`. TypeScript `BoardRedrawLayoutOptions` / `BoardForceGraphLayoutOptions` expose `lockedNodeIds`; `layoutBoardFixtureRedrawNodes` passes them through JSON. Play redraw snapshots and `boardPlayRedrawLayoutOpts` thread filtered graph node ids from `lockedIds`. Added Rust tests (`force_graph_pins_locked_node_positions`, `redraw_force_graph_top_level_locked_node_ids_pins`) and Vitest `keeps locked node coordinates fixed on force redraw`. Verified `cargo test -p elements_board locked` and `bunx vitest run` after `wasm-pack` rebuild so `rs/pkg` matches the native implementation.
